## Scope

Use this template for the public course definitions and program catalogs.
Book chapter-to-edition mappings and purchasing/resource listings are
maintained outside this specification repository. For changes to the
shared educational requirements, follow the
[RFC process](https://github.com/0xbuffdev/open-engineering-education/blob/main/rfcs/README.md).
